LanguageData.NMC_CarrierAttackDesc: Designate a visible unit or damageable building. New and airborne interceptors focus this target. Launch range: 60 cells; pursuit range from the carrier: 80 cells. Out-of-range orders remain active until cancelled or the target is lost.
LanguageData.NMC_CarrierMustFly: Take off and finish folding before issuing an attack order.
LanguageData.NMC_CarrierAutoDesc: Launch interceptors and select hostile targets automatically. A designated target takes priority even when this is off. Recall cancels the order and disables automatic sorties.
LanguageData.NMC_CarrierClearDesc: Clear the designated target. Interceptors resume automatic targeting if automatic sorties are enabled.
